file.protection.note: ledger row: file.protection — Protection-tab Encrypt button (data-cmd=protectDialog, same command as backstage btn-fileprotect) opens #protect-dialog (editor.js:8288-8311 protectDialog, protectionError starts empty); dialog carries the restrict/password/editable-range controls

file.cut-ctrl-x.note: ledger row: file.cut-ctrl-x — toolbar Cut button runs document.execCommand("cut") (editor.js:9745-9748); the runner's placed selection is "Will" (first 4 chars of the demo h1 "Willkommen bei World Office"), so the h1 reads "kommen bei World Office" afterwards

file.copy-ctrl-insert.reason: #btn-copy runs document.execCommand("copy") (editor.js:9747) — it writes the OS clipboard only; no DOM mutation, status change or wo:* event is emitted, and the runner's assertion vocabulary cannot read the clipboard (headless clipboard-read is permission-denied), so Copy has no observable contract effect
file.copy-ctrl-insert.note: ledger row: file.copy-ctrl-insert — real gap: clipboard write is invisible to DOM-observer assertions; honest xfail

file.copy-style-ctrl-alt-c.reason: OO's Copy style (Ctrl+Alt+C) is a format painter; WO ships no copy-style control anywhere in editor.js (no copyStyle/formatPainter wiring — census fuzzy-matched #btn-copy), and clicking #btn-copy executes a plain clipboard copy with no style-state observable
file.copy-style-ctrl-alt-c.note: ledger row: file.copy-style-ctrl-alt-c — real gap: no WO format-painter control exists; honest xfail

file.paste-ctrl-v.note: btn-paste reads navigator.clipboard.readText — browser context has clipboard permissions (_boot) and seedClipboard writes the headless system clipboard
